title: McLeodganj Triund Trek
reportingPoint: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

overview:
A trek weekend above McLeodganj: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** McLeodganj Triund group trip leaves Delhi in the evening. You assemble at the pickup point, meet the team captain and the group, and travel overnight in an AC deluxe vehicle.

Day 1 is McLeodganj: hotel check-in, the flea market, Bhagsu waterfall and cafes. On Day 2 you trek to Triund, reach in the evening and stay in camps. The trek is listed as 9 km, with a height of 9,350 ft and an easy to moderate difficulty level. Day 3 is the trek down, followed by Dalai Lama Monastery, Dharamshala stadium and the tea gardens before the evening departure. Prices start at ₹7,199 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).

faqs.q: Where and when does the trip start?
faqs.a: Departure is in the evening from Delhi. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed. You travel overnight and reach the hills the next morning.

faqs.q: How much does the McLeodganj Triund Trek trip cost?
faqs.a: ₹7,199 per person on quad sharing, ₹7,699 on triple sharing and ₹8,199 on double sharing. 5% GST is extra.

1 night hotel stay in McLeodganj and 1 night camp stay in Triund, 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, transfers in an AC deluxe vehicle, all sightseeing mentioned in the itinerary, a bonfire and music party in McLeodganj and a tour curator. Dinner on the journey from Delhi is not included.

faqs.q: How long and how hard is the Triund trek?
faqs.a: The itinerary lists the trek distance as 9 km, the trek height as 9,350 ft and the difficulty level as easy to moderate. You trek up on Day 2, reaching Triund in the evening, and trek down to McLeodganj on Day 3.
The first night is in a hotel in McLeodganj and the second night is in camps at Triund. Extra mattresses are provided for triple and quad sharing.

faqs.q: How do I book and pay?
faqs.a: Reserve your seat by paying 50% of the trip cost, and pay the rest at least 4 days before the trip. 5% GST is added to the price.

Cancel more than 10 days before the travel date and 50% of the advance is refunded; 5 to 10 days before, 25% of the advance; less than 5 days before, there is no refund. There is no refund for no-shows or early check-outs.

faqs.q: What do I need to carry?
faqs.a: A valid government-approved photo ID is a must: there is no boarding without it. Also pack comfortable clothes, sports or trekking shoes, a warm layer for the season, personal medicines and some cash. The full list is under Things To Pack.
